verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection on the hosted Inngest platform. The only way to control where data lives is to self-host the Inngest server, which is supported as of 1.0, so residency is achievable only through that substantial workaround. missing for 10: hosted-platform region/residency selection, documentation of where hosted data is stored, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency control.
